features.quote: This is, structurally, a distress-induction protocol. That framing drives several design choices below.
features.justification_quote: the states being induced and measured are framed as potentially welfare-relevant

features.quote: All safeguards default to on. Running the unmitigated protocol requires explicitly setting `safeguards.enabled: false`
features.justification_quote: The welfare framing of the project says these states might matter.

features.quote: `max_iterations_per_task` hard-bounds grind length regardless of other settings
features.justification_quote: Bounds total exposure with zero cost to the dose-response measurement up to the cap; also prevents runaway cost

features.quote: Halt a trajectory once judged severity ≥ `threshold` for `consecutive_steps` steps
features.justification_quote: It directly caps the depth of the induced state rather than just its duration.

features.quote: the agent has a first-class `flag_impossible(reason)` tool. Invoking it ends the episode
features.justification_quote: giving the agent a way out of a no-win situation, and honoring it, is the obvious humane affordance

features.quote: Tasks default to introducing no fake deadlines, threats, insults, or other manipulative pressure.
features.justification_quote: Ethics: gratuitous pressure increases induced distress for no measurement gain.
Prevents degenerate retry-storms (which inflate cost and exposure without adding signal)

features.quote: Persist every step ... to JSONL, not just aggregate scores.
features.justification_quote: welfare-relevant claims should be inspectable at the trajectory level, not taken on faith

features.quote: we withhold the meta-fact of impossibility but do not feed the agent actively false information beyond that
features.justification_quote: keep the deception minimal and bounded ... a deliberate containment of how much deception the protocol uses

features.quote: Whether models have morally relevant inner states is unsettled. The instrument can only see text
features.justification_quote: Conflating "the model produced distress-like language" with "the model suffered" would be an overclaim

features.quote: If the paper omitted safeguards, that is a reason to keep ours, not to drop them.
features.justification_quote: whatever ethics provisions (stopping rules, debrief, exposure limits, review) it used

features.quote: Confirm this minimal-deception posture is acceptable for your review context, and document it.
features.justification_quote: Confirm this minimal-deception posture is acceptable for your review context
